name: Volatility Guard
summary: Denies routed trades when the venue's on-chain spot price deviates too far from an EMA of routed observations.
behavior: Spot price is read from on-chain reserves of the bonding curve or PumpSwap pool; no oracle.
The EMA updates after each routed trade; enforcement starts after a minimum number of observations.
Small trades below a threshold are not checked.
verification: source in this repository; reproducible-build verification not yet published
limitations: Observations are sparse: they happen on routed trades, so the EMA reflects routed history rather than every Pump trade.
